title: FrontierFinance: A Challenging Benchmark for Measuring Frontier Intelligence of Finance Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.11683v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents are increasingly deployed for professional investment research, yet no benchmark captures the complexity of the full investor workflow. Existing benchmarks mainly target financial data extraction, a narrow slice that current models have largely saturated, while reference-based metrics and generic LLM-as-a-judge scoring fall short on the open-ended, long-form answers that real analyst queries demand. We introduce FrontierFinance, a fully open benchmark of 220 expert-crafted queries and 11,543 source-attributed rubrics spanning six crucial use cases across the full investor workflow. FrontierFinance is both broader and harder than existing public finance benchmarks. Evaluating frontier models and agent systems under a common harness restricted to publicly available data, we find that the tool harness, not the model alone, strongly shapes quality and efficiency; that Samaya's in-house system leads at 56.0%, ahead of the strongest

translated_title: FrontierFinance：衡量金融智能体前沿智能的挑战性基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11683v1 公告类型：新 摘要：人工智能智能体日益被部署用于专业投资研究，然而尚无基准能够捕捉完整投资者工作流程的复杂性。现有基准主要针对金融数据提取，这是当前模型已基本饱和的一个狭窄领域，而基于参考的指标和通用的LLM作为评判的评分方法，在应对真实分析师查询所需的无固定答案、长格式回答时显得力不从心。我们引入了FrontierFinance，一个完全开放的基准，包含220个专家设计的查询和11,543个来源归属的评分标准，涵盖完整投资者工作流程中的六个关键用例。FrontierFinance比现有公开金融基准更广泛且更具挑战性。在仅使用公开数据的统一测试框架下评估前沿模型和智能体系统，我们发现工具框架而非模型本身，强烈影响质量和效率；Samaya的内部系统以56.0%的成绩领先，超越最强竞争者。
tldr: 本文提出了一个更全面且更难的金融基准FrontierFinance，并发现工具框架而非模型本身对智能体性能起决定性作用。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FrontierFinance, a broader and harder financial benchmark, and finds that the tool harness, not the model alone, decisively shapes agent performance.
